_about: Moment → sticker reaction map for the grimhaven.stickers subsystem. Packs are referenced by their Telegram set short-name only; NO file_id is stored anywhere, because a file_id is bot-specific, can expire, and quoting a foreign one is a guaranteed 400 (see docs/STICKERS.md §Reliability). The bot resolves ids at runtime with getStickerSet and keeps them in memory.
_licensing: Only packs approved by the operator live here. The Grimhaven discovery run (2026-10-12) also catalogued xianxia/donghua packs (MDZS, TGCF and manhua character sets) — those are NOT enabled, because they are fan-art of copyrighted commercial works and the operator chose the generic anime-reaction set instead. The full research pool stays at agent/research/sticker-pool.json.
_selection: A moment names a category; a category lists emoji in preference order. The service prefers a sticker whose Telegram emoji tag matches, and otherwise rotates deterministically through the pack (so the same picture never repeats twice in a row). Nothing is hard-required: if no pack resolves, the game simply keeps playing with text.

victory.note: won a duel, a hunt or a conquest

defeat.note: lost a fight, a hunt or a duel

calamity.note: tribulation failure — qi deviation, annihilation. The crying faces are last on purpose: the calamity reads better as shock than as tears, but a pack that only ships tears must still get its best sticker picked rather than a random one.

milestone.note: realm jump — the grandest progression step

reflection.note: quests, study, alchemy, reading a scroll

victory.note: throttled per zone like the victory vista — a sticker on every kill would be spam

breakthrough.note: once per attempt via the attempt-counter once_key

breakthrough_fail.note: the same key space as breakthrough: one attempt → at most one reaction

milestone_realm.note: realm jump rides the breakthrough attempt key, so it can never double-post
